questions.:question/problem:
Consider the augmented matrix $M,$ given by

$$
M=\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & 3 & 9 & 1 \\ 5 & -1 & 2 & 1 \\ 5 & 2 & -1 & 1\end{array}\right].
$$

What matrix results from carrying out the row operation ${R}_{2}:={R}_{2}+(-1)\cdot {R}_{3}$ on $M?$
questions.:question/worked-solution:
The operation ${R}_{2}:={R}_{2}+(-1)\cdot {R}_{3}$ means that we need to add $-1$ times the third row to the second row.

Applying this row operation, we obtain the following:

$$
\begin{aligned}M & =\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & 3 & 9 & 1 \\ 5 & -1 & 2 & 1 \\ 5 & 2 & -1 & 1\end{array}\right]\,{R}_{2}:={R}_{2}+(-1)\cdot {R}_{3} \\  & ∼\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & 3 & 9 & 1 \\ 5+(-1)(5) & -1+(-1)(2) & 2+(-1)(-1) & 1+(-1)(1) \\ 5 & 2 & -1 & 1\end{array}\right] \\  & ∼\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & 3 & 9 & 1 \\ 0 & -3 & 3 & 0 \\ 5 & 2 & -1 & 1\end{array}\right]\end{aligned}
$$

$$
\begin{aligned}A & =\left[\begin{array}{cc|c}4 & -1 & 9 \\ 6 & 5 & -6 \\ -1 & -9 & 1\end{array}\right]\,{R}_{1}↔{R}_{2} \\  & ∼\left[\begin{array}{cc|c}6 & 5 & -6 \\ 4 & -1 & 9 \\ -1 & -9 & 1\end{array}\right]\end{aligned}
$$

$$
V=\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}-1 & 9 & -2 & 6 \\ 4 & 4 & 6 & 7 \\ 9 & 0 & 5 & 7\end{array}\right].
$$

What matrix results from carrying out the following row operations on $V?$

$$
\begin{aligned}{R}_{1} & ↔{R}_{3} \\ {R}_{2} & :={R}_{2}+(-1)\cdot {R}_{3}\end{aligned}
$$
questions.:question/worked-solution:
Let's list the required operations:

- The operation ${R}_{1}↔{R}_{3}$ means that we need to swap the first and third rows.

- The operation ${R}_{2}:={R}_{2}+(-1)\cdot {R}_{3}$ means that we need to add $-1$ times the third row to the second row.

Applying the operations, we obtain the following:

$$
\begin{aligned}V & =\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}-1 & 9 & -2 & 6 \\ 4 & 4 & 6 & 7 \\ 9 & 0 & 5 & 7\end{array}\right]\,{R}_{1}↔{R}_{3} \\  & ∼\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}9 & 0 & 5 & 7 \\ 4 & 4 & 6 & 7 \\ -1 & 9 & -2 & 6\end{array}\right]\,{R}_{2}:={R}_{2}+(-1)\cdot {R}_{3} \\  & ∼\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}9 & 0 & 5 & 7 \\ 4+(-1)(-1) & 4+(-1)(9) & 6+(-1)(-2) & 7+(-1)(6) \\ -1 & 9 & -2 & 6\end{array}\right] \\  & ∼\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}9 & 0 & 5 & 7 \\ 5 & -5 & 8 & 1 \\ -1 & 9 & -2 & 6\end{array}\right]\end{aligned}
$$

Applying this row operation, we obtain the following:

$$
\begin{aligned}M & =\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & 0 & 2 & 3 \\ 0 & -2 & 1 & 4 \\ 1 & -1 & 1 & 2\end{array}\right]\,{R}_{3}:={R}_{3}+(-1)\cdot {R}_{1} \\  & ∼\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & 0 & 2 & 3 \\ 0 & -2 & 1 & 4 \\ 1+(-1)(1) & -1+(-1)(0) & 1+(-1)(2) & 2+(-1)(3)\end{array}\right] \\  & ∼\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & 0 & 2 & 3 \\ 0 & -2 & 1 & 4 \\ 0 & -1 & -1 & -1\end{array}\right]\end{aligned}
$$

questions.:question/problem:
Consider the augmented matrix $U,$ given by

$$
U=\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & 0 & 2 & -2 \\ 0 & 2 & 0 & 6 \\ 0 & -1 & -3 & 4\end{array}\right].
$$

What matrix results from carrying out the following row operations on $U?$

$$
\begin{aligned}{R}_{2} & :=\frac{1}{2}{R}_{2} \\ {R}_{3} & :={R}_{3}+{R}_{2}\end{aligned}
$$
questions.:question/worked-solution:
Let's list the required operations:

- The operation ${R}_{2}:=\frac{1}{2}{R}_{2}$ means that we need to multiply the second row of the matrix by $\frac{1}{2}.$

- The operation ${R}_{3}:={R}_{3}+{R}_{2}$ means that we need to add $1$ times the second row to the third row.

Applying the operations, we obtain the following:

$$
\begin{aligned}U & =\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & 0 & 2 & -2 \\ 0 & 2 & 0 & 6 \\ 0 & -1 & -3 & 4\end{array}\right]\,{R}_{2}:=\frac{1}{2}\cdot {R}_{2} \\  & ∼\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & 0 & 2 & -2 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 & 3 \\ 0 & -1 & -3 & 4\end{array}\right]\,{R}_{3}:={R}_{3}+{R}_{2} \\  & ∼\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & 0 & 2 & -2 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 & 3 \\ 0+0 & -1+1 & -3+0 & 4+3\end{array}\right] \\  & ∼\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & 0 & 2 & -2 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 & 3 \\ 0 & 0 & -3 & 7\end{array}\right]\end{aligned}
$$

questions.:question/problem:

$$

questions.:question/worked-solution:

Multiplying the $3$rd row by $-\frac{1}{3}$, we obtain the following:

$$
\begin{aligned}A & =\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & 3 & 8 & -1 \\ 7 & 1 & -9 & 4 \\ 6 & -3 & 9 & 0\end{array}\right]\,{R}_{3}:=\left(-\frac{1}{3}\right)\cdot {R}_{3} \\  & ∼\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & 3 & 8 & -1 \\ 7 & 1 & -9 & 4 \\ \left(-\frac{1}{3}\right)\cdot 6 & \left(-\frac{1}{3}\right)\cdot (-3) & \left(-\frac{1}{3}\right)\cdot 9 & \left(-\frac{1}{3}\right)\cdot 0\end{array}\right] \\  & ∼\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & 3 & 8 & -1 \\ 7 & 1 & -9 & 4 \\ -2 & 1 & -3 & 0\end{array}\right]\end{aligned}
$$

$$
